text:
Tess (Recruiter): heads up — urgent offer routing for candidate relocating internationally. Manager requesting comp-band uplift + split sign-on. Need quick approval path. Details: role Senior ML Eng, candidate relocating US->UK, requested start 2027-04-01 (earlier than planned), base requested $190,000, band max $175,000, sign-on total $30,000 split 50/50 with 6mo clawback. asking for 15% over band and split sign-on. candidate id: C-4127.
Maya (People Ops): can you paste the exact ask numbers and short justification? also flag if any visa/tax complications.
Tess (Recruiter): sure — ask summary:
- Base: $190,000 (band max $175,000 -> +8.57% over band max; manager requests 15% comp-band exception to make comp flexible)
- Sign-on: $30,000 total -> pay $15k at start, $15k after 6mo with clawback clause if leaves before 12mo
- Relocation stipend: separate $10k lump (standard)
- Reason: candidate countered; competing offer remote + earlier start requirement due to product timeline. Manager wants candidate to start 4/1 to hit Q2 milestones.
Ajay (Hiring Manager): adding rationale — candidate has unique infra experience, will unblock vector infra work. If we lose them, timeline slips 6+ weeks. Budget exists in headcount pool if we do the uplift.
Kari (Finance): quick Q — is the uplift front-of-book or total comp? also need GL code for the sign-on and relocation. keep in mind currency conversion for UK payroll.
Tess (Recruiter): uplift affects base; sign-on charged to hiring team Opex GL 540-210; relocation to benefits GL 540-307. Currency will be converted at offer time; prefer to issue sign-on in USD and gross-up for UK with payroll.
Maya (People Ops): thanks. two approvals needed: comp-committee approval for >10% over band, and People Ops final sign-off for split sign-on/clawback. propose routing to comp-committee now — do we have Elena available? @Elena could you triage?
Elena (Comp Committee): @Maya reviewing now. quick read: 15% uplift seems high but acceptable if justification strong. prefer to cap to 12% unless hiring manager confirms critical. also need written acknowledgement on clawback and early-start staffing plan.
Ajay (Hiring Manager): can confirm critical; timeline impact severe. I'm comfortable with the 15% request given net ROI. we can commit a 12-week onboarding plan and milestones tied to second sign-on tranche.
Maya (People Ops): proposed decision path:
1) Comp committee: approve uplift (15% requested, committee may counter to 12%)
2) People Ops: approve sign-on split + clawback terms
3) Finance: confirm GL and payroll currency handling
4) Recruiter: issue updated offer once approvals in thread
Tess (Recruiter): copying offer snippet for legal/OPS review:
```
Offer{
  candidate_id: C-4127,
  base_usd: 190000,
  band_max_usd: 175000,
  uplift_requested_pct: 15,
  sign_on_total_usd: 30000,
  sign_on_schedule: [15000_on_start, 15000_after_6mo_with_clawback],
  relocation_usd: 10000
}
```
Kari (Finance): GLs confirmed. payroll team flagged UK gross-up; add note in offer to net after tax conversion. approve finance side pending comp committee.
Elena (Comp Committee): leaning approve. I need one-line written justification from Ajay for the committee minutes (impact + comparators). Ajay — can you post that here?
Ajay (Hiring Manager): justification: candidate reduces expected infra delivery delay from 6 weeks to 0; recruiting timeline shows 2 other strong contenders but this candidate's system-level experience is unique. Market comp at repo shows median for similar role in London equivalent to $195k USD; 15% uplift keeps us competitive. recommending approval.
Maya (People Ops): noted. Comp committee votes: @Elena approve, @Maya approve conditional on clawback language, @Kari finance ack. Elena — do you want us to route to formal committee doc or is this thread sufficient?
Elena (Comp Committee): thread is fine for urgent hire. Approve 15% uplift for this candidate — final sign-off to People Ops for offer language. :white_check_mark:
Maya (People Ops): approved. People Ops to finalize split sign-on language and clawback: standard 6mo clawback prorated over 12mo.
Tess (Recruiter): thanks all — I'll update offer and route to OnboardBot once signed. tagging OnboardBot to trigger offer generation.
OnboardBot: Offer package generated for C-4127. Sending to candidate email on file.
Tess (Recruiter): :party-parrot: candidate notified, awaiting signature. will follow up if candidate counters.
